title: Ethereum just hit a new all-time high and nobody noticed

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ethereum just broke its all-time high — and no one’s talking about it.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could be the moment crypto finally goes mainstream.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ethereum hit $4,000 for the first time ever this week.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s using a new upgrade called "Cancun" to cut fees in half.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects millions of users who rely on Ethereum for apps and DeFi.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway: Ethereum is becoming cheaper and more efficient than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s next for crypto’s biggest rival to Bitcoin?

caption_text: Ethereum just hit a new all-time high and nobody noticed
